contracts: All selected inner projections execute eagerly in written order. Retained CellValue rows move across stages without stored-schema coercion or intermediate strict publication; aliases, raw UTF-16, Error, declarations and policy completion survive.
Each positive unordered TOP counter advances at its own delivery boundary before downstream filters; omitted rows still perform upstream eager checks and physical EOF remains mandatory.
Each stage and terminal accumulator phase restores lexical ownership on Result failure. Terminal leaf namespace resolution remains separate and uses only operation-root authorized immutable bindings.

All table leaf schemas are preflighted across all arms, then rechecked before each cursor outside callbacks. Captured keys are re-resolved and provider identity is pinned within execution, not asserted across prepare as physical identity.

Only row-local inner SELECT stages are admitted. Inner UNION, stateful aggregation/grouping, crosstab, active duplicate elimination, sorting and discovery refuse before any cursor; no Runtime read/materialized-cache fallback exists.

Direct zero-stage arms allocate no frame capacity. Cumulative query/native work remains separate; existing generated Count under 8 KiB passes unchanged. Sticky first sink/query failure stops later callbacks, stages and arms.
independent_controls: Root and two external sources reuse same table/named names without lexical leakage; explicit target selectors still use the root registry. Equal-schema provider remap after initial runtime registration is independently detected before scans.
Generated 100,003 inputs cross three named stages without buffered callbacks, with exact aggregate models. Repeated named uses have independent counters and cumulative limits.

Raw/Error observers, full String policy/completion cohorts, real String conflicts, paired prepare/execute metadata, typed parameters, EOF-first final aggregates, late schema drift, all observed cancellation points and sink/source failures are covered.
